Over three decades, we’ve evolved with the semiconductor industry—from early ISA and PCI multi-I/O cards to advanced PCIe 100GbE/200GbE and OCP 3.0 solutions. With manufacturing in China, Malaysia, and Taiwan, Sunrich is known for engineering excellence and reliability.
